{{Top|leg}}
'''Graphite''' was a construction material. Spun graphite was a strong and flexible material that was used in the construction of [[Force pike/Legends|Force pikes]],<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> such as [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[Controller FP/Legends|Controller FP]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
